# Semantic UI

> A reactive web component framework built on signals and web standards

Base URL: https://next.semantic-ui.com

## Start Here

Load the mental model first — it covers the foundational concepts (defineComponent, template syntax, reactivity, Query, specs) that everything else builds on:

/content/ai/essentials/mental-model.md

## What Do You Need?

**Using UI components in a project?**
1. /content/specs/index.md — list of components (button, card, modal, etc.)
2. Fetch a spec: /content/specs/{id}.json — returns JSON with attributes, variations, states, settings
3. /content/examples/index.md — working code examples grouped by category
4. Fetch an example: /content/examples/{id}.json — returns source files as JSON
5. /content/ai/usage/index.md — AI-optimized guides for using components

**Building custom components with the framework?**
1. /content/ai/authoring/index.md — AI-optimized guides for authoring components
2. /content/docs/index.md — user documentation (guides and API reference)
3. Fetch a doc: /content/docs/{path}.md — returns markdown

**Contributing to Semantic UI?**
1. /content/ai/contributing/index.md — architecture, testing, code style, workflows

**Building your own UI framework or design system?**
1. /content/ai/research/index.md — research corpus analyzing UI primitives across React, Vue, Angular, Svelte, etc. This was the research foundation for Semantic UI's component specs.

All index URLs above return markdown lists of available content. Each item includes a path you can fetch to get the full content.

---

## Reference: API Endpoints

The rest of this file documents the full content API for tooling, scrapers, and programmatic integrations.

**Manifest formats** (available for each content type):
- `index.md` — markdown list, most token-efficient
- `index.min.json` — JSON with slim metadata
- `manifest.json` — JSON with full metadata

### Component Specs

Machine-readable component API definitions.

| Format | Path |
|--------|------|
| Markdown | /content/specs/index.md |
| JSON (slim) | /content/specs/index.min.json |
| JSON (full) | /content/specs/manifest.json |

Fetch spec: /content/specs/{id}.json

### Examples

Code examples with source files.

| Format | Path |
|--------|------|
| Markdown | /content/examples/index.md |
| JSON (slim) | /content/examples/index.min.json |
| JSON (full) | /content/examples/manifest.json |

Fetch example: /content/examples/{id}.json

### User Documentation

Guides and API reference in markdown.

| Format | Path |
|--------|------|
| Markdown | /content/docs/index.md |
| JSON (slim) | /content/docs/index.min.json |
| JSON (full) | /content/docs/manifest.json |

Fetch page: /content/docs/{path}.md

### AI Context

Documentation optimized for AI agents, organized by audience.

| Format | Path |
|--------|------|
| Markdown (all) | /content/ai/index.md |
| JSON (all, slim) | /content/ai/index.min.json |
| JSON (all, full) | /content/ai/manifest.json |

Per-audience indexes:

| Audience | Markdown | JSON |
|----------|----------|------|
| usage | /content/ai/usage/index.md | /content/ai/usage/index.min.json |
| authoring | /content/ai/authoring/index.md | /content/ai/authoring/index.min.json |
| essentials | /content/ai/essentials/index.md | /content/ai/essentials/index.min.json |
| contributing | /content/ai/contributing/index.md | /content/ai/contributing/index.min.json |
| research | /content/ai/research/index.md | /content/ai/research/index.min.json |

Fetch content: /content/ai/{audience}/{slug}.md

### Full Manifest

All content types combined. For tooling, scrapers, and indexing systems.

/content/manifest.json
